paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Monolingual vs. multilingual datasets over time. While monolingual datasets are more frequent, around 2017 researchers began producing multilingual datasets.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets associated with different languages over time, from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2022 and marked with yearly increments. The vertical axis represents the number of datasets, plotted on a logarithmic scale, starting at 1e0 and extending to 1e7. The value axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and contains tick labels with intervals of 10, representing the logarithm of the dataset count. There are three colored bars representing different categories: blue bars indicate datasets associated with “1” language, orange bars represent datasets associated with “2+” languages, and a yellow bar represents datasets associated with “1+” languages. In 2012, the blue bar represents a value of approximately 3, the orange bar a value of approximately 2, and the yellow bar a value of approximately 1.  The blue bar steadily increases from 2013 to 2022, peaking at a value of approximately 37 in 2022. The orange bar initially has a value of approximately 2 in 2012 and increases to a value of approximately 6 in 2016, after which it fluctuates around approximately 4.5 throughout the period. The yellow bar consistently reaches a value between 1 and 2 throughout the years.  The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
